summary: Immuron Ltd filed a Form 6-K with an attached FY26 sales update, reporting unaudited global sales of AUD$7.7 million, up 6% year-over-year, with segment breakdowns for Australia, Canada, and the USA. The filing is a routine operational update on sales performance and marketing initiatives for its Travelan product. No M&A, strategic review, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situation event is mentioned. The document is purely a periodic business update from a foreign private issuer, with no deal terms, board actions, or unusual corporate events.
